name: loopx
tagline: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams
description: loopx is a lightweight loop-engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams. It is agent-loop agnostic, working across Codex, Claude Code, and other coding agents, and provides durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake, executable todos, evidence logs, and verifiable handoffs. The project treats long-running agent work as a state machine that survives restarts, so a team of agents can keep making progress toward durable goals without losing context.
highlights: Durable goals, executable todos, and evidence logs for long-running agent teams
Quota-aware auto-wake keeps agents productive within budget
Verifiable handoffs between agents preserve context across sessions
Agent-loop agnostic: works with Codex, Claude Code, and more
curatorNote: Long-running agent teams need durable state, not just a loop that runs longer. loopx is the most complete open take on that problem — goals, wake-ups, and handoffs as first-class state.
